subject: Clarify observability add‑on: one‑time indexing & monthly retention fees
messages:
From: Sophie Carter <sophie@catalyst.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@catalyst.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify observability add-on: one-time indexing & monthly retention fees

Hi Avery / Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the dashboards looked great. Procurement asked me to get a few concrete numbers before we proceed:

- Can you confirm whether the "indexing" work for historical logs/trace reprocessing is a one-time professional service fee or included in the bundle? If one-time, what is the typical band (ballpark)?
- Monthly retention tiers: we need concrete limits (GB / retention days) and how overages are billed.
- Tracing pricing: is it per service-host, per span, or tokenized units?
- Advanced dashboard seats: how are they licensed (per seat or per viewer) and any seat minimums?

We'd like a draft SOW and a simple priced table we can attach to the internal procurement ticket. Our contract owner is reviewing total TCV and wants to understand whether the indexing fee can be amortized against committed usage.

Appreciate a short reply with an updated price sheet and SOW if you have one.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Carter
Head of Integrations, Catalyst Health
(Attachment: procurement-template.docx, 18 KB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify observability add-on: one-time indexing & monthly retention fees

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Naomi from Customer Success for operational detail on retention/overages and Marcus for commercial specifics.

Quick answers up front:
- Indexing: typically a one-time setup/ingestion reprocessing charge for backfills. Marcus will share a standard price band and a couple of amortization options.
- Retention: we have defined monthly tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days) with per-GB overage pricing; Naomi will confirm thresholds and sample invoice math.
- Tracing: billed by ingest volume (MB of spans) with a per-trace-unit rate; Naomi will include a mapping from spans to MB for your typical services.
- Dashboards: licensed per "editor" seat; viewer access is included for unlimited viewers by default.

Marcus / Naomi — can you attach the SOW template and the retention pricing sheet Sophie can pass to procurement? Sophie — if you can share projected monthly GB or number of services we can give a tighter amortization example.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: demo-screenshots.zip, 6 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify observability add-on: one-time indexing & monthly retention fees

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note. Attaching the SOW draft and a one‑page pricing table so procurement can slot numbers into the approval flow. Highlights below, and full table attached (retention-pricing-sheet.xlsx):

Summary pricing (list prices, negotiable with commit):
- One-time indexing / historical ingest: $15,000 (covers up to 10TB of historical data reprocessing; incremental $1,300 / TB).
- Monthly retention tiers (data ingest):
  • Starter: up to 2TB / month, 30-day retention — $2,500 / month
  • Growth: up to 10TB / month, 90-day retention — $7,000 / month
  • Enterprise: up to 25TB / month, 365-day retention — $18,000 / month
  • Overages billed at $0.12 / GB per month
- Tracing: $0.03 / MB of spans ingested per month (we provide a sample conversion sheet in the attachment).
- Advanced dashboards: $350 / editor seat / month (viewers free). Seat minimum: 3 editors.

Commercial flex for Catalyst Health:
- We can amortize up to 100% of the one-time indexing fee over a 12-month committed consumption schedule (min 12-month TCV of $250k).
- For a 12‑month commit, we can offer a 10% discount on the observability add-on list prices above.

Attached: SOW_Catalyst_v2.pdf (SOW draft), retention-pricing-sheet.xlsx (breakouts + sample invoice), conversion-guide.txt (span->MB mapping).
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (deal record) | https://www.docusign.com/signon/example-sign-link

Let us know the projected average monthly ingest (GB) and whether you want indexing split into two milestones (50% on kick-off, 50% on completion). Happy to put a one-page concession memo together for procurement.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: SOW_Catalyst_v2.pdf, 112 KB)
(Attachment: retention-pricing-sheet.xlsx, 24 KB)

From: Sophie Carter <sophie@catalyst.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@catalyst.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 07:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify observability add-on: one-time indexing & monthly retention fees

Thanks Marcus — the numbers help. Two quick procurement notes:

1) $15k indexing is higher than expected given our historical volume assumptions. Procurement asked whether that can be amortized and applied as a credit (we prefer crediting against monthly overage charges rather than a straight discount).
2) The seat minimum for editors (3 seats) is fine, but can you confirm if seats can be converted between teams during the term (we often shift editors between SRE and Platform).

If you can send a one-page concession memo that lays out the amortization mechanics (credit schedule vs. pure amortization), we can accelerate internal approval.

— Sophie
Sophie Carter
Head of Integrations, Catalyst Health

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify observability add-on: one-time indexing & monthly retention fees

Sophie — quick update and a path forward.

- Amortization vs credit: we can offer two options for procurement to consider:
  1) Amortize the $15k indexing over 12 months as an accounting spread on invoices (you pay $1,250 / month as part of the monthly bill).
  2) Apply the $15k as a credit against monthly overages (credit pool reduces overage charges until exhausted).

- Preconditions: either option requires a 12‑month minimum commitment at or above $250k TCV. If you accept the 12‑month commit, we will apply a 10% discount to the observability list prices.

- Seats: yes — editor seats are transferable between internal teams during the term (we just need a single admin to manage seat assignments; we'll add language to the SOW).

Marcus will prepare the one-page concession memo and an updated SOW that includes the amortization language and seat transfer clause. If Catalyst can confirm projected average monthly ingest (GB), Marcus can produce the exact amortization schedule and an example invoice for procurement to review.

Next steps: Marcus to send concession memo + updated SOW; Sophie to provide projected monthly ingest or agree to the 12-month TCV threshold.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: concession-memo-draft.docx, 9 KB)
